Laytee 0.17.0
AI translation (optional): add an OpenAI API key in Settings → AI and Laytee writes translations the way a native copywriter would, instead of word for word. It reads the app, the document name and, if you allow it, the design around your selection, so the copy fits its tone and space. Your key stays in the Keychain. The photo lens stays on this Mac, and if OpenAI can't be reached Laytee copies Apple's translation and tells you.
